ops.old:
q = "SELECT id, item, qty FROM orders WHERE id = '" + order_id + "'"
    conn = get_db()
    rows = conn.execute(q).fetchall()
ops.new:
q = "SELECT id, item, qty FROM orders WHERE id = ?"
    conn = get_db()
    rows = conn.execute(q, (order_id,)).fetchall()

patchset.rationale: Replace string-concatenated SQL with a parameterised query to prevent SQL injection while preserving behavior for valid ids.
